question: Is the ACCEPTED counter-label-support gate able to observe a counter-label-support regression on any packet the product can actually ship, and can that ability be added WITHOUT inventing a threshold and WITHOUT falsely blocking an accepted artifact that is strictly better on the rate?
hypothesis: H-LABEL-LINEAGE. The accepted counter-label gate is population-confounded: it can emit a regression verdict only when the scored-row population equals the incumbent 65 (accepted finding L3: 1 of 3 accepted-lineage packets admissible). Consequently a packet whose counter-label support has collapsed to 0.0 is admitted with gate_blocks_build=false (accepted finding L2, firing packet 38799024807 at 0/7), while the geometry gate blocks the same packet. Direction v50 mandates a RATE predicate ('label support below 5/65'), and the accepted implementation applies a COUNT predicate at a pinned population ('n_scored == 65 AND n_supported < 5'); accepted finding L4 shows those two readings disagree in the direction that fails a strictly BETTER artifact. Replacing the enforced predicate with direction's own rate reading, on the same qid-set lineage the geometry gate already uses, restores label-gate parity with geometry-gate blockability on the accepted lineage and removes the naive-consumer trap, inventing no number.
baseline: The ACCEPTED counter-label gate as accepted in cycle 38971202786: evaluation/frozen_bars/label_gate.py::score_packet, enumerated and digest-described by the accepted evaluation/frozen_bars/VERDICT_CONTRACT.json (sha256 b9cdb89438a8d16ee165fe2a5d73060524154d8e7ba8e0cab867e8ca17ff414c, which this cycle keeps byte-unchanged). the_only_number_used.why_rate_and_not_count: Direction v50's own sentence is a rate sentence: 'label support below 5/65'. Accepted finding L4_rate_and_count_semantics_disagree (enforced, holds=true) shows the count reading would FAIL accepted packet 38812599575, whose support rate 1/9 = 0.1111 is STRICTLY BETTER than the incumbent 0.0769. Enforcing the count reading would therefore falsely block an accepted artifact that is better on the mandated measure, which is the never-green loop direction v50 exists to avoid. The count reading is therefore retained, REPORTED and NOT ENFORCED, and the report states exactly which packet the two readings disagree on.
